description: This file defines a Drupal migration source plugin class 'Node' for migrating Drupal 6 nodes from the database. It includes methods for constructing database queries, handling translations, retrieving field info, and preparing data for migration.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A Drupal 6 node source plugin class for migrating nodes from the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the plugin with configuration, migration, state, entity manager, and module handler.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds the database query to retrieve node data, including handling translations and optional node types.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Initializes the iterator, setting default filter format.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array of field definitions for the node source.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each row for migration, setting default formats and ensuring translation info.

methods.name: getFieldValues
methods.description: Retrieves field values for a node based on its type.

methods.name: getFieldInfo
methods.description: Fetches field and instance definitions from the database for a given node type.

methods.name: getFieldData
methods.description: Retrieves raw field data for a node from the database.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the primary key for the source data, which is 'nid'.

methods.name: handleTranslations
methods.description: Modifies the query to filter nodes based on translation settings.
